extracted.name: The Best Zucchini Cake with Pudding l Quick and Easy Recipe l For Holidays, Any Occasion
extracted.description: Today I will make the best zucchini cake ever. This is a simple, quick, and easy recipe. Moist, perfectly delicious, and fragrant cake with walnuts, cranberries, spices, and pudding on the top. It's really a delicious veggie cake for your family for Easter, Christmas, holidays, any occasion. Healthy and tasty at the same time.
ingredient_lines: 250 g flour (50:50 all-purpose flour and whole wheat flour)
300 ml soy milk + water for mixing pudding powder + 2 tbsp sugar
instruction_lines: Use zucchini or apples, if you don't have zucchini. Grate it in bigger stripes- leave it to rest so it will produce juice.
Chop cranberries and walnuts. Beat eggs with brown sugar and add oil. Sift flours and all the spices. Add baking soda and lemon zest.
Mix everything. Squeeze zucchini out and add it to the batter, mix all the ingredients.
Bake with parchment paper. Bake it at 180-200 at 25-30 min.
Roast almond flakes and prepare the pistachio pudding.
Once the cake is ready and has cooled down coat it with pistachio pudding and sprinkle almond flakes on the top.
Bon Apettite!! You can find the whole recipe on my Yummy By Elena Channel: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yffMDfL9sCE&t=200s
